title: Add a PR preview build and comment
body:
**What**

Adds a `preview` job to CI that builds the service for an incoming PR and posts a comment with the preview status, so reviewers do not have to check out the branch locally just to confirm it builds.

**Why**

Reviewers keep pulling PR branches locally to sanity-check that `npm run build` still passes before they read the diff. Posting that result as a comment saves the round trip.
